Specification: This module defines a trivial one-variable temporal specification over the variable x and several invariant-style operators that exercise LET-bound recursive-function syntax and nested local definitions. The behavior specification requires x to be initially TRUE and then remain unchanged forever via a stuttering-only temporal formula. The remaining operators are state-level expressions intended to test recursive and non-recursive LET-defined functions, nested LET scopes, and local operator application rather than to model a distributed algorithm or fault-tolerant protocol.
IfThenElse: IF i = 1 THEN x = TRUE ELSE recfcn[1]
IF i = 1 THEN x = TRUE ELSE innerA[i]
